title: capability-support
description: One observation of what a provider offers for a capability. The dimension says what kind of fact it is: a missing feature is 'unsupported' only for the feature dimension; an exhausted quota is a resource fact, a prohibition is a policy fact, and a failing dependency is a health fact. None of those three is expressed as 'unsupported'.

observed_at.description: When the fact was observed (ISO-8601, UTC).

fresh_until.description: Until when a probed or inferred fact can be trusted (ISO-8601, UTC).

remediation.description: What to do to obtain the capability.

evidence.description: Pointer to the proof of the fact, such as a document or a probe result.

level.description: native: provided directly; adapted: provided through an adapter; unsupported: not provided.

source.description: declared: stated in a manifest; probed: checked against the live provider; inferred: derived from other facts.

dimension.description: feature: what the provider can do; resource: what is available now (quota); policy: what is allowed; health: whether a dependency works.
